LESSON: SCRIPTURAL STORIES AND FAMILY VALUES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Scriptures (Dharam Granths)
Topic 3.1: Scriptural Stories and Family Values
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Scriptural Stories and Family Values, part of Scriptures (Dharam Granths) in Grade 5 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How do Scriptures contribute to instilling moral values? 2. How can we apply moral values in different situations in the family?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. mention scriptures that they familiar with,

2. use search engines to identify the role of the Scriptures and make presentation in class,

3. listen to stories/resource person/ audio- visual device to find and tell stories from Scriptures that explain their roles as carrier of moral values,

4. recite mantras from Scriptures based upon their roles to instil moral values,

5. watch animated stories of Scriptures of four faiths,

6. make discussions on the role of Scriptures,

7. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching to make them understand the lessons drawn from the stories of Scriptures. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. mention scriptures that they familiar with,
2. use search engines to identify the role of the Scriptures and make presentation in class,
3. listen to stories/resource person/ audio- visual device to find and tell stories from Scriptures that explain their roles as carrier of moral values,
4. recite mantras from Scriptures based upon their roles to instil moral values,
5. watch animated stories of Scriptures of four faiths,
6. make discussions on the role of Scriptures,
7. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching to make them understand the lessons drawn from the stories of Scriptures. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Scriptural Stories and Family Values together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
